summary.title: How to build a news app with React Native
summary.one_liner: You learn how to build a news headline app in React Native that fetches articles from News API, displays them in a FlatList with pull-to-refresh, and opens full articles via Linking.
keywords: react native project structure src components
how to open article url in app
takeaways: Fetch headline JSON from News API with the Fetch API using a free API key.
Render a list of articles with FlatList and pull-to-refresh driven by component state.
Build an Article card with react-native-elements and moment to show relative publish times.
Open the full article in the browser on press using Linking.openUrl.
summary.summary: This tutorial walks through building a simple news reader in React Native. It covers signing up for News API to get a key, creating a getNews fetch helper, and managing articles and refreshing state in a class component. An Article component uses react-native-elements and moment to render cards with images, descriptions, source names and time, and taps open the article URL with Linking. The code is shown step by step with a link to a GitHub repo.
